hypothesis: Apply bounded label-free denoising teacher forcing during corpus-prior pretraining by replacing 5% of molecular input tokens with the existing UNK token while retaining every clean next-token target, so the autoregressive GRU learns to recover from locally imperfect prefixes instead of learning only exact corpus-prefix continuations.
method_name: Augmented Hill-Climb autoregressive SMILES policy optimization
method_thesis: Pretrain an autoregressive SMILES language model on the allowed unlabeled corpus and freeze a copy as the molecular prior. During each objective session, sample complete molecules de novo token by token from a trainable agent, rank the accepted molecules by their observed oracle rewards, and update the agent only on the highest-reward fraction using the Augmented Hill-Climb loss: the squared gap between agent log-likelihood and a target formed from prior log-likelihood plus scaled reward. Excluding low-reward samples from policy updates prevents them from repeatedly pulling the agent back toward the prior, while prior likelihood still regularizes the elite updates; this concentrates the scarce feedback on sequences associated with improvement of final Top-1 without screening a finite molecular pool.

method_tags.proposal_mechanism: ancestral token sampling from an online reward-conditioned molecular policy

Report prior unique-valid canonical rates for all three assigned preparation seeds and the pooled count-summed rate. applicability_conditions: The corpus vocabulary must retain the published UNK token and enough eligible molecular-token inputs for a 0.05 corruption probability to produce a stable nonzero denoising signal; PAD, BOS, EOS, and existing UNK positions are never corruption candidates.

The mechanism is most applicable when invalid ancestral strings arise partly from compounding errors after the policy reaches prefixes absent from clean teacher-forced training, rather than from an irreducible vocabulary or molecular-validity mismatch.

Five-percent corruption is intended to be small enough to preserve the Parent's corpus distribution and next-token objective. If rare long-range syntax requires every preceding token exactly, corruption can worsen likelihood and ancestral support instead of improving recovery.

A higher task-agnostic unique-valid rate is only a support mechanism, not evidence that the added valid mass contains reward-reachable chemistry. Node n-b992903add3b increased this broad preparation proxy slightly but reduced three-seed macro score, so benchmark utility still requires the registered score comparison.

Preparation remains strictly label-free and task agnostic, and transfer requires the unchanged two-file model/configuration artifact, vocabulary indices, special-token meanings, architecture, and downstream sampling and likelihood interfaces to load successfully.

The claim is scoped to the supplied 250000-example reservoir, five-epoch GRU training schedule, three preparation seeds, and 0.05 input-corruption rate; other corpora, tokenizations, model families, schedules, or corruption strengths require a new comparison.
research_intent.falsifier: The mechanism did not happen if no eligible molecular input tokens are replaced, if the realized replacements include PAD, BOS, EOS, or targets, if the corruption RNG is not derived solely from the preparation seed, or if the pooled three-seed prior unique-valid rate fails to exceed the Parent's 645/768 reference. If support increases but macro score does not, the mechanism activated without useful reward-search transfer.
research_intent.implementation_change: Keep the Parent's corpus reservoir, eligibility window, tokenizer, vocabulary construction, model dimensions, recurrent dropout, optimizer, learning rate, batch order, five epochs, clean next-token targets, support-check stream, artifact filenames and schema, and every run-mode Layer unchanged. Add only a fixed 0.05 teacher-forcing input-token corruption during corpus pretraining: construct a dedicated torch Generator from the supplied preparation seed so the new mask does not consume the Parent's global model/dropout RNG stream; in every training batch clone the input tensor, independently replace selected non-PAD, non-BOS, non-EOS, non-UNK molecular token positions with the existing UNK index, and compute the unchanged cross-entropy against the original clean targets. Log eligible and replaced counts per epoch and serialize the fixed corruption rate as preparation metadata; inference and ancestral sampling remain uncorrupted.
research_intent.mechanism: Apply bounded label-free denoising teacher forcing during corpus-prior pretraining by replacing 5% of molecular input tokens with the existing UNK token while retaining every clean next-token target, so the autoregressive GRU learns to recover from locally imperfect prefixes instead of learning only exact corpus-prefix continuations.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: Parent n-6174d6127af5 trains exclusively on clean corpus prefixes, but its own three-seed ancestral evidence shows that this teacher-forced fit does not fully survive free running: pooled complete-conditioned novel-valid yield is 0.825692368639032, and the weakest prepared artifact reaches only 0.7832720190434971 despite all batches eventually filling. Thus the limiting active-layer behavior is lack of exposure to imperfect autoregressive prefixes, leaving roughly one sixth of completed samples outside novel valid support. The checkpoint-only Child n-b992903add3b raised pooled preparation unique-valid rate by just 4/768 while reducing macro score by 0.008551034406275007, so changing which clean-trained epoch is published does not settle this distinct prefix-robustness mechanism.

applicability_conditions: The refutation applies to the supplied 250,000-example unlabeled-corpus reservoir procedure, corpus-derived vocabularies of sizes 74, 76, and 78, five-epoch GRU schedule, preparation seeds 0 through 2, and fixed 0.05 independent UNK-input corruption rate.

Operational applicability is established: every corpus supplied more than 11.6 million eligible molecular-token inputs per epoch, every epoch realized a nonzero fraction tightly around 0.05, special tokens and existing UNK positions were excluded in source, clean targets were retained, and the corruption RNG was derived only from the preparation seed.

Beneficial applicability is not established for the observed Parent bottleneck. Under the unchanged preparation-seeded support check, no seed exceeded its paired clean-training Parent and the pooled rate decreased from 0.83984375 to 0.7799479166666666.

The evidence does not determine whether a lower rate, token-class-aware masking, span corruption, or another denoising symbol could help; each would be a different mechanism or setting and requires a new comparison. It likewise does not transfer to another corpus, tokenizer, model family, training duration, or support-check stream.

Interface compatibility remains supported despite refutation of the behavioral claim. All three preparations published the frozen smiles_prior.pt plus smiles_policy.json interface, and all fifteen downstream objective sessions completed their full 300-call budgets with no evaluator-level invalid or duplicate attempts.

The observed decrease in preparation support and in three-seed macro score provides no support for retaining 0.05 UNK corruption as a useful preparation mechanism merely because its execution receipt is correct.

possible_failure_causes: The central prefix-recovery premise was not supported in this regime. Unique-valid support fell on all three preparation seeds, by 21, 4, and 21 molecules out of 256 respectively, so exposure to UNK-corrupted prefixes harmed or failed to improve free-running canonical support rather than repairing the Parent's compounding errors.

UNK is forbidden during ancestral sampling, whereas approximately five percent of eligible training inputs are replaced by UNK. This creates a train-inference context mismatch: capacity spent modeling recovery from an artificial token may reduce precision on the entirely UNK-free prefixes encountered at sampling time. The present artifacts establish the mismatch and adverse direction but do not isolate it causally from other effects of noisy conditioning.

Uniform independent token corruption is not aware of SMILES syntax. It can mask ring-closure, branch, bond, or bracket-token context whose exact long-range relationship is needed for grammatical continuation, so a nominally small token rate can disproportionately disrupt sequence constraints. The logs do not stratify replacements by token class, so this remains a possible rather than identified cause.

Each support estimate uses one fixed 256-draw panel per preparation and therefore has finite resolution. However, the pooled shortfall is 46/768 and every paired seed moves downward, so panel variation would need to reverse a consistent adverse result; these replicas still do not establish behavior under another audit stream or more draws.

Benchmark utility also moved adversely rather than rescuing the failed broad-support proxy. Candidate seed val_scores are 0.504437516849167, 0.48458778923272, and 0.484800925714467 versus paired Parent values 0.544472616912355, 0.498752613558053, and 0.499594775007781. This score evidence does not determine why support fell, but it provides no evidence that the lost broad valid mass was exchanged for more reward-reachable chemistry.
